nonfinal_contradiction_binding.statement: CP1 fail-closed gate contradiction: 416×208 landscape + canonical 127×254 x/z aspect cannot also put z head rail at bottom/foot toward top without portrait letterboxing; current NONFINAL mapping would anisotropically distort 4×. Visual gutter makes policy more necessary. I stopped before test/PASS/production. root_orientation_decision_binding.statement: Root裁定选 A：landscape canonical 2:1 table，z长轴水平，head rail=LEFT、foot=RIGHT；禁止anisotropic distortion。416×208 plot按canonical aspect并预留对称视觉gutter，双语HEAD/开球端与FOOT/底端标签消除方向歧义。请冻结V19 orientation/layout interpretation correction gate+validator/mutations，绑定原gate与NONFINAL contradiction；不改production/CMake/GPU/readiness。

supersession_contract.superseded_text: 2:1 play-surface orientation; head rail at bottom and foot spot toward top for every camera
supersession_contract.replacement: Landscape canonical 2:1 play-surface orientation; z long axis is horizontal, head rail is LEFT and foot rail is RIGHT for every camera.

corrected_orientation_contract.canonical_axes: screen horizontal is canonical z long axis; screen vertical is canonical x short axis
corrected_orientation_contract.mapping_formula: screen_x = table_rect_left + ((z + 127) / 254) * table_rect_width; screen_y = table_rect_top + ((x + 63.5) / 127) * table_rect_height

reference_gutter_contract.responsive_algorithm: Reserve at least 12 reference pixels after the existing UI-scale transform on all four plot sides, then center the largest exact 2:1 canonical table rectangle inside the remaining plot area. Extra unused space is split equally across the corresponding opposite sides.
reference_gutter_contract.complete_silhouette_must_remain_inside_p: Actual rail halos, paired endpoint capsules, direction notch, predicted outer rim and diamond endpoint must remain inside the plot rectangle and outside header, legend, border and toggle regions.

required_new_positive_fixtures: all 96 cases use exact uniform canonical scale and byte-identical orientation/source mapping across camera presets
reference mapping sends z=-127 to left, z=+127 to right, x=-63.5 to top and x=+63.5 to bottom
reference table rect is exactly [plot+24, plot+12, 368, 184]
rail-edge, corner and endpoint silhouettes remain within the plot after the complete visual gutter
HEAD / 开球端 and FOOT / 底端 remain ordered, visible and outside the trajectory denominator

uniform 12-pixel inset stretched to 392x184 instead of refitting exact 2:1
